Premium website for MKLabs — Software Development & Technology Solutions.

## 📦 Tech Stack
- Pure HTML/CSS/JS (no framework needed - ultra fast)
- Glassmorphism UI + Aurora mesh gradients
- Scroll animations (fade in + fade out)
- Dark/Light mode toggle
- WhatsApp direct with draft messages
- AI Assistant (rule-based knowledge base)
- Google Maps Bulawayo glass integration
- Premium floating pill nav (Tekzanda inspired)
